name: cow-protocol-performance-test-suite
description: Performance testing suite for CoW Protocol Playground using K6

scripts.test: npm run build && k6 run dist/load-test.js
scripts.test:light: npm run build && k6 run dist/load-test.js --env SCENARIO=light
scripts.test:medium: npm run build && k6 run dist/load-test.js --env SCENARIO=medium
scripts.test:heavy: npm run build && k6 run dist/load-test.js --env SCENARIO=heavy
scripts.test:spike: npm run build && k6 run dist/load-test.js --env SCENARIO=spike
scripts.test:rampup: npm run build && k6 run dist/load-test.js --env SCENARIO=rampup
scripts.test:stress: npm run build && k6 run dist/load-test.js --env SCENARIO=stress
scripts.test:soak: npm run build && k6 run dist/load-test.js --env SCENARIO=soak
scripts.test:custom: npm run build && k6 run dist/load-test.js --env BASE_URL=$BASE_URL

author: bleu
